name: Disaster Simulation and Recovery Certification Design
description: Design the disaster simulation framework for testing recovery procedures against defined RTO/RPO targets. Define simulation scenarios (single-node loss, database corruption, network partition, region failure, credential compromise, cascading failure), simulation orchestration, observation hooks, and outcome measurement. Design the recovery evidence certification process that produces signed attestations proving RTO/RPO compliance after each drill, including automated evidence collection, witness logs, and exception handling for failed drills.
purpose: Without regular disaster simulation and formal certification, RTO/RPO targets are theoretical. A simulation framework with automated evidence collection provides measurable confidence that recovery procedures work under realistic failure scenarios and produces audit-grade certification artifacts.
acceptanceCriteria: Simulation framework design defines scenario inventory, orchestration model, observation hooks, and outcome measurement per RTO/RPO target
Certification process design defines automated evidence collection, signed attestation format, witness logs, and exception handling
Architecture document covers simulation scheduling, isolation from production, and rollback from failed drills
